overview_description.description: Karaz Health is a diabetes ecosystem and infrastructure using AI and data to help individuals in managing their daily diabetic care. Karaz's diabetic health monitoring solution makes it simple to manage diabetes and connect with specialists for questions, support, or a personalized program. Karaz also offers diabetic supplies, telemedicine, personalized diabetic coaching, and everything else people need to take charge of their health.

about_short_description.short_description: Karaz Health is a diabetes ecosystem and infrastructure using AI and data to help individuals in managing their daily diabetic care.

product.name: Karaz Intelligent EHR System
product.description: An AI-driven electronic health record system that supports personalized and continuous diabetic care management through real-time data and device integration.

product.name: Karaz Mobile Application
product.description: A free mobile app for individuals to monitor diabetes, receive personalized health insights, and engage with a community through continuous tracking and rewards.

product.name: Data-Driven Diabetic Care Plans
product.description: Personalized diabetic management plans based on data analytics and AI insights to optimize treatment and lifestyle adjustments.

product.name: At-Home Lab Testing Service
product.description: A service enabling diabetic patients to perform laboratory tests at home, facilitating convenient health monitoring and data collection.

identifier.value: Diabetic Psychological and Behavioral Health Support

product.name: Diabetic Psychological and Behavioral Health Support
product.description: Remote psychological and behavioral health support via phone or video to assist diabetic patients in managing mental and behavioral aspects of their condition.

product.name: Prediabetes and Weight Management Plan
product.description: A structured program focused on managing prediabetes and weight through personalized plans and continuous monitoring.
